outline:
Pre-requisition: Basic concepts in statistics

Course Syllabus：
(1) Statistics Fundamentals for Engineering – A brief review
	Terminology and jargons
	Probability distribution, sampling、t-Test、F-Test, etc.
	Test and hypotheses
	The Tool: MS Excel
(2) One-/multi-way DOE and ANOVA
	General introduction and Steps of DOE
	One-way ANOVA
	Two-way ANOVA
	DOE with multi-variates (optional)
(3) Blocking in DOE
	Complete Blocking
	Incomplete Blocking
(4) Latin Squares (optional)
(5) Factorial Designs & ANOVA
	2k Full
	Fractional
(6) Regression Analyses
	Linear
	Response Surfaces (optional)
(7) Robust Design: Taguchi’s method
	Cf. PPTs and handouts
(8) Nested Designs
(9) Monte Carlo Simulation (optional)
(10) Application Examples and Discussions
assessment:
Outcome Evaluation:
Homework/Class 40%, Mid-term Exam: 30%, Final: 30%.
